target_statement: Investigate the independently selected finite-seed family n_k=10^k-26 (k>=4) as a candidate outside the repository's named fixed-template constructions. Establish exact arithmetic formulas for initial reverse-add steps where possible, record reproducible finite orbit evidence, and determine whether the family yields a repeatable all-time-safe mechanism. No infinite-safe or P196 conclusion is assumed.
remaining_obligation: Search for an exact boundary-state recurrence for c=26 and c=1402; c=26 is affine in 10^k through t=14 and first ceases to be affine at t=15, while c=1402 first ceases at t=8.
